verdict.rationale: Gusto's evidence covers a newly launched business bank account (early beta, via Increase Bank) and a cash-flow dashboard. Nothing in the pack mentions issuing physical debit or credit cards to employees, or assigning card roles or permissions. Since Gusto now offers business banking, card issuance is a fair axis to ask about, but the pack contains no evidence of it.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can issue physical debit or credit cards to employees with defined roles
